nodes.label: call.addCandidate
nodes.rationale: Buffers candidates arriving before remoteDescription in pendingCandidates.

nodes.label: call.flipCamera
nodes.rationale: Swaps only the outgoing video track via replaceTrack without renegotiating the connection.

nodes.label: join form submit handler
nodes.rationale: Checks isSecureContext first because camera requires HTTPS or localhost.

nodes.label: CallException
nodes.rationale: Transport-agnostic exception converted by gateway exception filter into unified 'exception' event.

nodes.label: CallGateway
nodes.rationale: Gateway only receives events, calls service and emits results; decisions live in CallService.

nodes.label: CallService
nodes.rationale: Takes socket ID strings instead of Socket objects so it can be tested without WebSocket.

nodes.label: PiP 세로 / 태블릿 가로 분할 레이아웃
nodes.norm_label: pip 세로 / 태블릿 가로 분할 레이아웃

nodes.label: ICE candidate
nodes.rationale: Ephemeral network path candidates; relayed immediately, not persisted.

nodes.label: ontrack 중복 srcObject AbortError 버그
nodes.rationale: ontrack fires per audio/video track; re-assigning the same stream aborted play(), falsely showing tap-to-play.

nodes.label: room_code 부분 유니크 인덱스 (status <> ENDED)
nodes.rationale: Allows reuse of codes of ended rooms while keeping active rooms unique.

nodes.label: 순수 WebSocket (ws)
nodes.rationale: Rejected: lighter but requires implementing rooms and reconnection manually.

nodes.label: SDP
nodes.rationale: Ephemeral connection data; not stored in DB to avoid latency and load.

nodes.label: SFU (미디어 서버)
nodes.rationale: Rejected: suitable for multi-party but excessive for 1:1.

nodes.label: Signaling (시그널링)
nodes.rationale: Server only relays SDP/ICE; media flows P2P between devices, so server load stays minimal.

nodes.label: socket.io
nodes.rationale: Chosen over raw ws because rooms and reconnection are built in and RN/Flutter clients exist.

nodes.label: TURN 서버
nodes.rationale: Carrier NAT on mobile data often defeats STUN alone; production needs time-limited temporary credentials.

nodes.label: 모바일 웹 HTTPS 필수
nodes.rationale: Mobile browsers block camera without HTTPS (except localhost); tunnels like ngrok/cloudflared used for device testing.

nodes.label: Nest 11 버전 고정
nodes.rationale: Nest 12 packages need core 12 and @nestjs/config/typeorm 12 are ESM-only, breaking Jest.

nodes.label: 비관적 락 (SELECT FOR UPDATE)
nodes.rationale: Lock expresses intent most clearly and cost is negligible at 1:1 scale; unique-constraint trick rejected as less clear.

nodes.label: 유니크 위반 1회 재시도
nodes.rationale: When no room row exists the lock cannot protect creation; partial unique index rejects 2nd INSERT (23505), so retry once to find and lock the created room.

nodes.label: 웹 vs 앱 클라이언트 차이
nodes.rationale: Server is identical for web and app since SDP/ICE are standard; only client rendering, permissions, background behavior differ.

nodes.label: WebRTC P2P 연결
nodes.rationale: For 1:1 calls P2P minimizes server load and latency; SFU would be overkill and is only needed for multi-party.

nodes.label: CallRoom Entity
nodes.rationale: State transitions happen only through canAccept/markJoined/markLeft; capacity constant lives in the entity.

nodes.label: onApplicationBootstrap 재시작 정리
nodes.rationale: Loads stale rows and mutates via entity methods instead of bulk UPDATE; only valid with a single server instance.

nodes.label: 통화방 상태 머신 (WAITING/ACTIVE/ENDED)
nodes.rationale: One leaving returns to WAITING rather than ENDED so the peer can rejoin.

nodes.label: socket.io Redis adapter
nodes.rationale: Needed to scale to multiple servers, along with changing restart cleanup.

nodes.label: 서버 재시작 시 잔여 상태 문제
nodes.norm_label: 서버 재시작 시 잔여 상태 문제

nodes.label: TypeORM 마이그레이션
nodes.rationale: Chosen over synchronize:true to manage change history and column comments and avoid schema loss.
